summary: Dominion Energy filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement on June 3, 2026, for the issuance and sale of $825 million aggregate principal amount of 5.35% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes are issued under a shelf registration statement on Form S-3 and are senior debt securities, with Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, PNC Capital Markets, and U.S. Bancorp as representatives. This is a routine debt offering—not a special situation—with no change of control, restructuring, or strategic event. No risk-arb angle or event-driven catalyst exists beyond ordinary debt capital markets activity.
